AMD FidelityFX API headers (MIT, Copyright (C) 2025 Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; license text in
each header), unchanged, as vendored by github.com/Astyyyyy/fsr4-vk (`third_party/fidelityfx-api`).
Used by `src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_fsr4_upscaler.cpp` to call an FSR 4 upscaler library
(`amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_vk.so`/`.dll`, loaded at run time from `EDEN_NX2_FSR4_LIB` or the user
folder). No AMD library is included.
